speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing right groin pain and have abnormal leg positioning after a rear-end collision. Can you tell me exactly how your leg was positioned at the moment of impact?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Posterior Dislocation of the Right Knee.

The mechanism of injury (rear-end collision with the car being pushed) combined with immediate knee and groin pain is highly suggestive of a posterior dislocation. Can you describe how the right leg was positioned immediately after the crash?
